title: Ops automation that removed a week of manual work

proof: Run logs, failure alerts and weekly time savings are tracked and shareable.

title: WhatsApp AI assistant for a regional carrier

proof: Reply times, qualified-lead counts and agent workload are measured before and after launch.

title: Agent guardrails starter kit
what: An open source kit that puts permission checks, output validation and audit logs between an AI agent and its tools.
proof: The test suite throws adversarial prompts at the agent and fails the build if anything unsafe gets through.
how: Wrote per-tool policies that approve or block each action
Validated every output against a strict schema
Added spend and loop limits with a tamper-evident log
